name: Tano
description: Tano is an AI-powered influencer marketing management platform delivered as an AI-native creator marketing agency. End-to-end creator partnership ads on TikTok and Instagram.

skills.name: Creator Sourcing
skills.description: Find and vet creators matched to brand objectives across TikTok and Instagram.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a brand needs to find creators for influencer marketing campaigns, product gifting, or affiliate programmes. Best for brands spending $5K+ on creator partnerships.
skills.instructions: Visit https://tano.ai and book a call to discuss creator sourcing requirements. Provide brand name, target audience, budget range, and platform preference (TikTok or Instagram).

skills.name: Creator Partnership Ads
skills.description: End-to-end creator ad campaign management with whitelisting and ad-ready assets.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a brand wants to run paid ads using creator content on TikTok or Instagram. Tano handles sourcing, contracts, content production, and whitelisting permissions.
skills.instructions: Visit https://tano.ai/pricing to estimate costs, then book a call. Provide campaign budget, target creator follower tier, number of creators needed, and platform.

skills.name: Product Gifting
skills.description: Source creators and manage gifting logistics to collect UGC content.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a brand wants to send products to creators in exchange for organic content. Priced at $1.85 per creator, supporting 20–500 creators per campaign.
skills.instructions: Visit https://tano.ai/pricing to calculate costs. Book a call to provide product details, target creator profile, and desired content format.

skills.name: Affiliate Programme Management
skills.description: Recruit, onboard, and manage creators in your affiliate channel.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a brand wants to build or scale an affiliate creator programme. Priced at $2.10 per creator per month, supporting 10–1,000 creators.
skills.instructions: Visit https://tano.ai/pricing to estimate monthly costs. Book a call to discuss affiliate programme goals and existing setup.
